high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a dark background, which creates a dramatic and focused effect on the subject. The individual is wearing an elegant, strapless gown that combines a metallic gold corset-like top with a flowing black skirt. The corset has a textured, almost sculptural appearance, giving it a unique and eye-catching look. The black skirt is pleated and extends down to the floor, adding volume and movement to the outfit. The person's hair is long, straight, and dark, cascading over their shoulders and partially covering one side of their face.
